command:
from pyscipopt import Model
from pyscipopt import quicksum
m = Model()
x = m.addVar(vtype='B')
y = m.addVar(vtype='B')
m.setObjective(0)
m.setObjective(m.getObjective() + 2.5 * x)
m.setObjective(m.getObjective() + 4.0 * y)
m.addCons(quicksum([x, y]) <= 2)
m.setMaximize()
m.optimize()
assert abs(m.getObjVal() - 6.5) < 1e-08
assert m.getVal(x) > 0.99 and m.getVal(y) > 0.99
print('objective', m.getObjVal(), 'status', m.getStatus())
